instrument_finding.headline: The T=15k outcome-blind pre-check does NOT screen the deployed fabric. It tests a DIFFERENT object: obs chi2 is a fresh noisy draw per (seed, T), sitting near a ~1%-level threshold. s10 passes at 15k and fails at 1M; s36 fails at 15k and passes at 1M -- exact mirrors.
consequences: A pre-check pass carries NO guarantee at the deployed horizon (s10).
A pre-check failure is NOT evidence of a defective deployed fabric (s36).
The BINDING gate is the assert inside run_exp14_arm at h_max -- which every one of the 38 successful runs passed. The delivered sample is therefore clean at the horizon that matters.
Screening N seeds at a level-alpha assert produces ~alpha*N rejections BY CONSTRUCTION. A rejection is evidence of a defect only if it is HORIZON-STABLE (s23 was; s10 and s36 are not).
instrument_finding.recommendation_routes_to_jason: Run the outcome-blind pre-check at the DEPLOYED horizon, or declare the T=15k screen advisory and name the run-time assert as the gate. Do NOT relax any threshold. This is the band lesson applied to the instrument: verify a rejection against the assert's own false-alarm expectation.
